During the [[Alderaan Civil War]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Nefarid]] maintained a '''hideout''' in the [[Glarus Valley]]. After a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] deactivated the [[Death Mark laser]]'s generators at the [[Mensaav Military Laboratory]], Nefarid moved the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon's]] central computer to his hideout. The Knight would eventually [[Battle in Nefarid's hideout|attack]] the facility and defeat Nefarid in a duel, after which the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] destroyed the Death Mark's computer.
